Class PopulationMixParametricAnalysis

java.lang.Object
common.definitions.parametric.ParametricAnalysisDefinition
common.definitions.parametric.PopulationMixParametricAnalysis
All Implemented Interfaces:
ParametricAnalysis
public class PopulationMixParametricAnalysis extends ParametricAnalysisDefinition

Title: PopulationMixParametricAnalysis

Description: this class is used to describe a parametric analysis where the varied parameter is the population mix between two closed classes.It adds the classKey field used to keep the key of the Job-Class whose service time will be varied. This type of parametric simulation is available only when there are exactly two closed classes.

Author:
Francesco D'Aquino Date: 14-dic-2005 Time: 11.51.51

      public int checkCorrectness(boolean autocorrect)
      Checks if the PA model is still coherent with simulation model definition. If the autocorrect variable is set to true, if the PA model is no more valid but it can be corrected it will be changed.
      Specified by:
      checkCorrectness in class ParametricAnalysisDefinition
      Parameters:
      autocorrect - if true the PA model will be autocorrected
      Returns:
      0 - If the PA model is still valid
      1 - If the PA model is no more valid, but it will be corrected
      2 - If the PA model can be no more used
